outcome: Reductions in hemoglobin and hematocrit levels
cohort: 300 women eligible for elective cesarean section in two institutions in Egypt
finding: Intrauterine misoprostol (400 mg) added to oxytocin was safe and effective in decreasing the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage and reducing postpartum blood loss in women undergoing elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Intrauterine misoprostol (400 mg) added to oxytocin is safe and effective in decreasing the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) and reducing the amount of postpartum blood loss in case of elective CS delivery.
